newsitem.title: FRANCE: BASKETBALL-PAU'S RIGAUDEAU SIGNS FOR BOLOGNA.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-PAU'S RIGAUDEAU SIGNS FOR BOLOGNA.

text.p: France's top basketball player Antoine Rigaudeau, who won the French championship with Pau-Orthez in 1996, has signed for Virtus Bologna of Italy.
Rigaudeau, voted France's most valuable player five times, signed a four-year contract with Virtus, 13 times Italian champions, starting next season.
The 25-year-old French international, whose dream is to play one day in America's NBA, missed half of the season just ended with an elbow injury.
